item.title: Supernova (tournament)
item.description: Supernova (formerly known as Super Smash Con) is an annual Super Smash Bros. convention and tournament series, previously held at the Dulles Expo Center in Chantilly, Virginia, and at Baltimore Convention Center since 2026. The event is held in early August and focuses on the video game series published by Nintendo along with other video games, and features tournaments for every entry in the series. Side events have featured other platform fighters, including Rivals of Aether, Slap City, and Nickelodeon All-Star Brawl.
